# NextVector

> NextVector is an independent artificial intelligence intelligence platform and frontier model benchmark radar filtering marketing noise to deliver verified technical disclosures, LMSYS Chatbot Arena leaderboards, head-to-head model showdowns, and buyer guides.

NextVector operates under a strict empirical editorial charter: Less noise. More signal. Verified benchmarks over marketing claims. Founded and edited by Robiul Hasan (https://rhasan.online). All reporting is primary-source verified and rated using a 1–100 Signal Purity formula.

## Core Intelligence Hubs
- [NextVector Home](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/): Real-time verified AI news feed, breaking signal marquee, and lead intelligence report.
- [AI Models Directory](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/models): Interactive database of 135 frontier and open-weight AI foundation models with architecture, token pricing, context windows, and Arena Elo ratings.
- [Model Showdowns & Comparisons](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/compare): Head-to-head architectural showdowns between leading frontier models (Claude vs ChatGPT, Opus vs GPT-6, DeepSeek vs OpenAI).
- [Best AI Subscriptions Buyer's Guide](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/subscriptions): Definitive 2026 buyer guide comparing ChatGPT Plus ($20), Claude Pro ($20), Gemini Advanced ($20), and ChatGPT Pro ($200).
- [Benchmark Radar & Leaderboards](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/benchmarks): Empirical leaderboards across LMSYS Chatbot Arena, OSWorld (computer use), WebArena (browser tasks), SWE-bench Verified (code), and Price-Performance Pareto.
- [AI Breakthrough Timeline](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/timeline): Chronological living record of verified paradigm shifts in foundation models, semiconductors, and computing fabrics.
- [Daily Intelligence Briefing](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/briefing): 3-minute executive morning intelligence scan for engineers and technology leaders.
- [Research Explained](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/research): First-principles technical dissections of seminal preprints and peer-reviewed computer science literature.
- [Complete Intelligence Archive](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/archive): Full crawlable HTML archive of all 154 published intelligence reports and 135 model dossiers.
